Class Overlay

java.lang.Object
net.murat.lovert.Overlay
Direct Known Subclasses:
OverlayImage, OverlayText
public abstract class Overlay extends Object
Base class for 2D overlays drawn on top of a rendered image. Subclasses: - OverlayText : draws a text string - OverlayImage : draws a bitmap All fields are public so a parser (e.g. SceneParser) can fill them directly. Anchor names follow the pattern TOP_LEFT, TOP_CENTER, ..., BOTTOM_RIGHT, CENTER. Margins and sizes are expressed as ratios of the image width/height (0..1).
